_comment: Routes merge-queue failures to an on-duty Slack user group. 'workflows' maps a workflow name to a team key; 'teams' maps that key to the Slack user-group handle (without the @). A failure whose failing step matches 'infraStepPatterns' is routed to infraTeam instead, because a broken runner, image pull or cache is a platform problem regardless of which workflow surfaced it. 'groupIds' is optional: fill in a team's S-prefixed user-group ID to make the mention a real ping without granting the bot the usergroups:read scope. Left blank, the ID is looked up at runtime and the mention falls back to unlinked text if that lookup is not permitted.
